scripts.test:php:graphql: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/barrio-suite env WP_GRAPHQL=1 vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.form: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/barrio-suite wp --require=dev/cli.php --user=admin barrio forms create
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/barrio-suite wp --require=dev/cli.php barrio forms seed
scripts.mailpit: docker run -d --rm --name barrio-mailpit --network $(docker network ls -qf name=wp-env-barrio-suite) -e MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY=1 -e MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 -p 127.0.0.1:8025:8025 axllent/mailpit:v1.21.8
scripts.zip:extensions: cd extensions && for e in */; do rm -f "../${e%/}.zip" && zip -qr "../${e%/}.zip" "$e"; done
